payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE: NDJSON backup/restore ported to the async SqlDriver — works on SQLite and Postgres (commit 44f3049). FrickStore.listAppliedMigrations async+portable + sqlDriver accessor; dump streams via the seam with dialect-aware table existence; restore uses SqlDriver.transaction + per-row SAVEPOINT (so a bad row doesn't poison the PG txn) + dialect-aware column introspection, dropping the SQLite-only PRAGMA foreign_keys (FK-safe via parent-first insert / child-first+cascade truncate). Validated end-to-end on real Postgres (dump→mutate→restore→verify) in createserver-postgres.test.ts. Server suite 781 green.
